fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Turnaround Space; Dense Vegetation
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the main residence and detached structure without obstruction.
• Identify and mark a designated turnaround point on the property so responding crews do not have to back out onto the road.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the access drive to maintain overhead and side clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so crews can move equipment between the two buildings.
• Mark or post the locations of all access points so arriving responders can quickly identify entry options without searching the property.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the sides of the access drive so responders can see the full length of the drive on approach.
• Keep at least one vehicle parking area clear at all times to give arriving units a staging area close to the structures.

wildfire.conditions: Open Terrain; Scattered Shrubs; Brush Area; Ground Vegetation; Scattered Trees; Multiple Access Routes; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the house and any outbuildings.
• Thin scattered trees near structures so their branches do not touch or hang over rooflines or walls.
• Cut back ground vegetation growing up against the base of the house on all sides.
• Clear brush from the area immediately surrounding any outbuildings or sheds on the property.
• Mow or cut down ground cover in the open areas between shrub patches and the house.
• Remove dead plant material from beneath shrubs and trees near the house.
• Trim tree branches that hang over the roof or touch exterior walls.
• Keep a clear, mowed strip along both sides of the driveway so vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Separate shrub clusters near the house so there is open ground between them rather than a continuous mass of vegetation.
• Cut back any brush that blocks sightlines around corners of the house or outbuildings.
